scope_note: fixture stubs Woo; no real transactions. Verified rendered states, controls, forms, focus and copy only. method: Playwright chromium (swiftshader), contexts 1440x900 DSF1 and 390x844 DSF2 mobile; scroll-dwell 0.85vh/650ms to bottom, back to top, image settle <=4s, then fullPage. Reduced motion variant for shop + 4 PDPs. No-JS (javaScriptEnabled:false) for shop + sg-005 with mouse.wheel scrolling and frame hashes. Keyboard: 14 Tabs from load per route; PDP reach loop to Size/Add-to-cart/size-guide opener; dialog open via Enter, close via Escape and via Close button. Registry via python -m skyyrose.core.product. Garment identity by eyes-on comparison of served card-front/PDP images against the registry front role (wordpress-theme/skyyrose-flagship/assets/images/products/).

findings.invariant: #sr2-product-views accessible name = published view count; PDP hero one dominant image
findings.observation: aria-label reads '0 published views' while the region renders one visible image (br-004-480w.webp, the derived approved card front, alt 'BLACK Rose Hoodie - front on model') - the accessible name contradicts the content [repro]. That fallback hero is laid out in a 761x576 landscape tile with the portrait image letterboxed (~50% void either side) and upscaled from a 384px-wide source into a 761px slot (naturalWidth 384), so the hero is soft at 1440 [repro]. No thumbnail rail renders. Root: data/opening-product-media.json products.br-004 = status REJECTED_AUTHENTICITY, views [] [repo]; the fixture maps attachment ids 2/201/202 to br-004 front/back/packshot previews [repo tools/v2-theme-preview.php:436-445] and the delivery layer discards them [inferred]. SG-005 is also views [] (STALE_PRODUCT_HASH) yet renders '2 published views', so the two statuses are handled differently [repro].

findings.invariant: single product registry is the SOT (founder authority)
findings.observation: opening-product-media.json's br-004 rejection reason describes a hoodie with a small wearer-left chest mark, longitudinal wearer-left forearm artwork, light floral hood lining, white drawstrings and no circular upper-arm patch [repo]; the registry record (get_product br-004, FOUNDER_PRODUCT_SPECIFICATIONS) specifies black-roses-cloud-cluster embroidered front_chest_center, all tonal black, drawstring hood [repro]. The served card and PDP image matches the registry detail-for-detail [repro eyes-on]. The two records conflict; the registry is the SOT and the media projection may be stale. Not adjudicated here - needs Corey to confirm which BR-004 specification is current so Agent C can clear or regenerate the published views.
